description: Koyomi: Calendars, Holidays and Helplines for AI Answers. Data that grounds what people ask AI about feelings, fortune, love and daily life: computed calendars for any date and place (sexagenary cycle, rokuyo, Japanese and Chinese lunisolar dates, 24 solar terms, moon, sun sign, 10 world calendars), world public holidays, verified crisis and listening helplines, and a consult map. Routes: /day (date, tz); /sun (lat*, lon*, date, tz); /range (from*, to*, tz, has); /rules; /topics; /holidays (country*, year, subdiv, lang, types); /countries (country); /helplines (country); /moon-phases (year*); /solar-terms (year*). Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /day, /sun, /range, /rules, /topics, /holidays, /countries, /helplines, /moon-phases, /solar-terms. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
